sources.title: BUS (band) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: BUS (stylized in lower case as because of you i shine) is a Thai boy band, and the first group to debut under Sonray Music, a label within Tada Entertainment. The group consists of twelve members, who were selected via participation on the competition reality show 789 Survival.
